company_info.description: Tera Technology, Inc. provides design, operation, and maintenance of information systems in Japan. The company offers electronic application system for local governments, billing acceptance system for care service providers, government integrated portal system, electronic approval system, support for big data operations in public institutions, and grant application system. It also provides mobile phone nationwide network design and management; music and video clip distribution system; telematics systems for commercial vehicles; authentication system for wi-fi hotspots; virtual network construction and control system; customer information DWH System; terminal configuration web system; location services for carriers; and carrier application infrastructure system. In addition, the company offers TV shopping e-commerce site development; e-commerce site development for individuals and corporations; magazine production support and department store point service system; delivery status management system for courier services; member site for healthcare professionals; customer management system for cosmetics manufacturers; infrastructure construction for cloud service providers; migrating existing systems to the cloud; and core systems for internet service providers. Further, it provides system environment to link multiple business processes; and designing mechanism to strengthen access restrictions to bank servers. Additionally, the company engages in the development of software and applications to be embedded in automotive equipment, industrial machinery, and other devices; in-house development and service deployment services under the ChatCo! Name. It serves public, communications, information services, finance, and manufacturing and others. The company was formerly known as Terra International Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Tera Technology, Inc. in February 2016. Tera Technology, Inc. was incorporated in 1991 and is headquartered in Toshima, Japan.
